name: Straneck's Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Argentina, paraguay, uruguay, and southern brazil
description: Small flycatcher with a gray head, an olive-brown back, a whitish throat, and a yellow belly. Note the white eyebrow and broken eye-ring.

name: Forbes's Blackbird
rangeDescription: Northeastern and eastern brazil, where very localized in pernambuco and alagoas, and northern minas gerais
description: Medium-sized, slim blackbird with uniform matte black plumage. Note the long straight bill with a straight upper mandible.

name: Chestnut-capped Puffbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to venezuela, northern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Attractive small puffbird of lowland rainforest. White below, reddish brown above, with a black mask and single black breast band.

name: Pemba Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Pemba (off northeastern tanzania)
description: A medium-sized, chunky pigeon that has an olive-green back and a gray head and underparts. Flight is fast and direct.

name: Tachira Antpitta
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (southwestern táchira)
description: Enigmatic large antpitta found only in southern Táchira, Venezuela. A “lost species” for many years until recently rediscovered there.

name: Rusty-flanked Treecreeper
rangeDescription: Mountains of western nepal to northeastern myanmar, southeastern tibet, and southwestern china
description: Well-marked treecreeper with a tiny bill, warm brown upperparts, and a dark brown ear patch on a white face. Warm rusty tones on the sides contrast sharply with a clean white throat and may meld into dark upperparts at a distance.

name: Yellow-rumped Munia
rangeDescription: Northern australia (cambridge gulf, western australia to arnhem land)
description: Small finchlike bird with brown wings, pale bill, and yellowish rump. Found in areas with tall grass, often in flocks beside rivers or floodplains, sometimes mixed with other seed-eating species.

name: Zarudny's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Desert of south-central asia (uzbekistan and turkmenistan)
description: Small, delicate pallid sparrow. Both sexes have pale gray upperparts, a black bib, black lines in front of the eyes (lores), sandy underparts, and large white wing patches.

name: Yellow-breasted Pipit
rangeDescription: Eastern south africa (mpumalanga southward to northeastern eastern cape) and lesotho
description: A medium-sized scaly-backed pipit. In breeding plumage, it is easily told by its canary yellow throat and breast.

name: South Polar Skua
rangeDescription: Breeds coastal antarctica, especially ross sea; also south shetland and south orkney islands (off antarctic peninsula); winters to northern offshore waters and north indian ocean: mostly clockwise to japanese and korean waters (western north pacific) and gulf stream of eastern usa (western north atlantic), then southwestern canada to northern baja california and northwestern africa
description: Bulky cold-brown seabird with white wing flashes. Usually seen singly in strong and direct flight, sometimes resting on the ocean with rafts of shearwaters.

name: Black-and-white Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of southern mexico to northern argentina and brazil
description: Rare but spectacular eagle of lowland tropical forest. Very rarely seen perched, when black mask, orange-yellow base of bill, and short black crest are distinctive.

name: New Guinea Megapode
rangeDescription: Northern new guinea and adjacent islands
description: A dark megapode of lowland and foothill forest. Dark, sooty gray underparts and neck, dark brown back and wings, dark legs, reddish face or throat, yellowish bill and an obvious pointy crest at the back of the head.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Blue Eared-Pheasant
rangeDescription: Montane forest of north-central china
description: A large gray terrestrial bird with an elegantly frilly tail. Bright red face and upswept white facial plumes (“ears”) are unique in its range.

name: Caatinga Antwren
rangeDescription: Caatinga of north-central and eastern brazil
description: Small antbird with a long, graduated tail. Males are mostly gray with a black crown, white eyebrow, and paler underparts.

name: Bald Parrot
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil (middle rio tapajós and possibly lower rio madeira)
description: A most remarkable parrot with an entirely bare orange head and nape. Note the bright orange shoulder patch and in flight the red underwings.

name: Pacific Hornero
rangeDescription: Far southwestern colombia (nariño), western ecuador, and northwestern peru
description: Thrush-sized, plump bird of open habitats, especially near water. Particularly fond of disturbed areas, often around human settlements, clearings, and roadsides.

name: Chestnut-cheeked Starling
rangeDescription: Southern sakhalin, kuril islands, and northern japan; winters to philippines, sulawesi, and borneo
description: Adult male glossy purple above, white below, with chestnut cheek patch, green wings, and white wing patch most noticeable in flight. Female gray-brown above, white below, and lacks the cheek patch; similar to a female Daurian Starling but less colorful, wing less marked.

name: Red-headed Bunting
rangeDescription: South-central eurasia; winters in indian subcontinent
description: Large, stocky bunting with a long tail. Rusty-red head and yellow body easily identify the breeding male; non-breeding male has restricted red on the head and a streaky brown back.

name: Siberian Pipit
rangeDescription: Northern to eastern russia in southeastern taymyr peninsula, western siberian plateau, and from eastward of lena river, yakutsk region, and lake baikal eastward to chukotskiy peninsula, commander islands, sakhalin, and kuril islands; winters from japan and korea to southern and southeastern continental asia; recorded westward to israel and turkey
description: Slender and drab songbird of open country. Brownish above with heavy streaking below.

name: Henderson Island Crake
rangeDescription: Henderson island (pitcairn archipelago)
description: An entirely deep black crake with bright reddish-orange eye-ring and legs. Bill is yellowish green.
